## The problem

What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way today?

## What you would like

Describe the behaviour, not the implementation, unless you have one in mind.

## Who it is for

Server operators, people using a client, developers using the SDK?

## Alternatives you considered

Including what you do today to work around it.

## Security and privacy

Does this change what an observer on the network can see, what is stored on disk, or what a server operator learns about users? If you do not know, say so.

## Would you work on it

Yes, no, or with some guidance.
